title: Your first look at Sculpt mode

steps.instruction: Open the mode menu that says Object Mode.
steps.spoken: Open the mode menu that says Object Mode.
steps.why: Sculpt mode is another mode, like Edit mode, with its own tools.
steps.hint_if_stuck: It is the first dropdown on the left of the 3D view header.

steps.spoken: Choose Sculpt Mode. Your mouse becomes a clay brush.
steps.why: Sculpting pushes and pulls the surface like pressing your thumb into clay.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Sculpt Mode is in the list under Edit Mode.

steps.instruction: Find the Radius setting in the top bar. It sets how big the brush is.
steps.spoken: Look at the top bar. Radius is the size of your brush, and Strength is how hard it presses.
steps.why: A big, light brush shapes the whole form. A small, strong one adds detail.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Radius is the first slider after the SculptDraw brush name.

steps.instruction: Open the mode menu that now says Sculpt Mode.
steps.spoken: Open the mode menu that now says Sculpt Mode.
steps.why: Always return to Object mode when you finish so nothing is changed by accident.
steps.hint_if_stuck: It is the first dropdown on the left of the 3D view header.

steps.spoken: Choose Object Mode to leave sculpting.
steps.why: Object mode is the safe home base.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Object Mode is the first item in the list.
